name: Queen of Sheba
summary: A queen who heard of Solomon's fame and came to Jerusalem to test him with hard questions. Amazed by his wisdom, she blessed the LORD and gave the king great gifts.

key_moments.title: Tests Solomon with Hard Questions
key_moments.description: The queen of Sheba came to Jerusalem with camels carrying spices, gold and precious stones. Solomon answered every question she asked him.

key_moments.title: Blesses the LORD and Gives Gifts
key_moments.description: She told Solomon that she had not been told even half of his wisdom, and she blessed the LORD who set him on Israel's throne. She gave him gold and spices, he gave her all she asked for, and she went home to her own land.
